object.description: Open a document in a Document Editor and look at the Export action. Choose an output path in the save dialog and run Export, with the PDF program replaced by a stand-in that returns a fixed PDF. Expected: the Export action is enabled, and the file at the chosen output path holds the PDF the stand-in made for the open document.
